description: Changes how new conversations are auto-assigned to the team, as the auto-assignment setting does: send any of enabled (on or off), pool (the org_members ids to hand new conversations to in turn; at least one person is required when enabled), and auto_classify_flows (whether incoming flows are classified automatically). Reversible. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: set_auto_assignment
title: Set conversation auto-assignment
